title: Exact Multi-Valley Envelope Function Theory of Valley Splitting in Si/SiGe Nanostructures
summary: Valley splitting in strained Si/SiGe quantum wells is a central parameter for silicon spin qubits and is commonly described with envelope-function and effective-mass theories. These models provide a computationally efficient continuum description and have been shown to agree well with atomistic approaches when the confinement potential is slowly varying on the lattice scale.
